questions.prompt: Button, one limp, 100bb, you hold AJs. Which size is the isolate?

choices.text: Raise to about your normal open plus one big blind
Check. The button cannot raise a limp.

questions.explanation: An isolate is a raise, sized up for the dead limp, not a flat.

questions.prompt: Under the gun limps and you are in the hijack with 72o. What do you do?
questions.explanation: A limp is not a signal to play trash. 72o does not isolate.

questions.prompt: You isolate a limper from the cutoff and the big blind calls as well. What changed?

choices.text: The pot is now heads-up by rule.
You should automatically stack off any pair.
You are multiway. Continue more carefully than in a heads-up raised pot.

questions.explanation: Isolation fails when extra players call. Speculative hands and bluffs go down in value.

questions.prompt: Deep stacks, several limpers, button with 76s. A sound plan is…

choices.text: Fold. Suited connectors hate multiway pots.
Limp only if you will call any later raise for 100bb.
Call or raise, planning to play a fit-or-fold flop rather than stack off preflop.

questions.explanation: Suited connectors gain from multiway implied odds and still should not commit 100bb with no pair.
